scope: Gameplay-only planning estimate; not overall beta completion or a test pass rate

rubric.rationale: Physical recoil regression first reproduced downward aim with an inverted legacy pitch scale, then passed with upward aim under either scale. Actual owned shots raise aim on the final hosted restart fixture. Existing 60% planning credit retained; normal-input packaged human recoil feel remains unaccepted.

Recoil direction corrected while look inversion, universal bracing, Stable Grip and deliberately variable wildcards remain. Arsenal content/animation/audio acceptance is unchanged; retain 50% planning credit.

Six encounters per regular arena, four bounded reinforcement groups, two finale approach encounters and a stronger champion replace the short two-wave levels. Connected party size scales numbers, role HP and damage, including downed members. Final solo and four-peer route fixtures exercise 21 encounters, caps and finite victory. Owner video reports the prior build too short/easy; fresh human pacing/balance acceptance and finished content remain open. Retain 60% planning credit.

Final four-peer route checks replicated encounter counters and actual role HP/damage multipliers. Final two-peer hosted test repeats two wipes/restarts, fresh pending state, retained XP, actual movement/fire/reload, upward owner recoil and late-join rejection. Historical four-peer restart and host-loss evidence stays dated; packaged Internet/human co-op remains open. Retain 70% planning credit.

Grounded combat/medic/movement direction and existing perk planning credit retained. Pending reinforcements cannot award premature wave-clear XP or advance the arena. No new perk-content credit; 75% in this category is not overall beta completion.

assessment_note: Retain the same 61.5 weighted / 62 displayed gameplay planning estimate. Correctness and pacing structure improve, but numeric tuning and controlled NPC defeats do not establish human balance, production content or overall beta acceptance.
